$comment: check:layers. A rule forbids tokens in the .rs files under `paths` (minus `except`); all paths are under crates/. A token matches as a whole word, and a trailing * matches any word that starts with it. Comment lines do not count. An `allow` entry exempts one file from one rule: {rule, path, why}. A rule that scans no file fails. An allow entry that matches no violation fails.

rules.name: core-is-pure
rules.why: the core is plain logic that every front end and every test can run: no process, terminal, network or FFI

rules.name: control-is-transport-only
rules.why: the protocol crate carries requests and replies; a client links it without linking the core

rules.name: cli-uses-the-socket
rules.why: with a daemon, the CLI reaches the core only through the control socket, so each capability has one path

rules.name: app-uses-the-socket
rules.why: with a daemon, the app reaches the core only through the control socket, so each capability has one path

rules.name: platform-owns-ffi
rules.why: only crates/app/src/platform may hold unsafe code or touch objc2 and AppKit; everything else calls its safe functions

rules.name: app-logic-is-pure
rules.why: only main.rs starts the platform, so the modules that decide what the window shows run in unit tests without AppKit

rules.name: pdf-lives-in-platform-pdf
rules.why: one file reads PDFs, through CoreGraphics and PDFKit; the core, the daemon, control and the CLI take a PDF only as a blob and its pages only as the backdrops and words the app sends
